en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
I might fall asleep...
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies

Don't worry, you won't be 
sleepy much longer.
Why? Because...

I'm going to tell you which of the 
movies here are true masterpieces!
Now then, what to start with?

Speaking of dominoes...have you heard 
of a Rube Goldberg machine?

It's a big mechanism made up of a bunch 
of stuff that chains like dominoes...
It's a unique form of art!

You'll feel nervous about whether it'll 
work and watch each part go...

That's it! I bet there's a movie 
here all about it!

You might feel that way...
but for me it's different.

There are many wonderful things that 
only exist in the world of fiction...

I think it's rude...for you to say 
something like that.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tsumugi looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Tsumugi's inner thoughts...?
